category_A_no_candidate_upstream_failure.description: Upstream pipeline failed to produce a non-empty candidate answer. Verifier was bypassed by design to maintain failure safety.

worker_malformed_function_call_anomaly.description: provider-reported MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL finish-reason anomaly despite native function calling being disabled

python_execution_failure.description: Deterministic Python sandbox failed, timed out, or code omitted FINAL_ANSWER marker.

empty_worker_response.description: Worker LLM returned empty string or whitespace.

category_B_candidate_wrong_completed.description: Upstream pipeline completed and produced a candidate answer, but candidate was incorrect under official scoring. Verifier evaluated candidate.

keep_preserved_incorrect.description: Verifier issued KEEP, preserving incorrect candidate answer.

revise_still_incorrect.description: Verifier issued REVISE, but revised answer remained incorrect under official scoring or had upstream completion failure.

verifier_fallback_preserved_incorrect.description: Verifier encountered schema/generation error and fell back safely to candidate.

comparative_failure_shift_vs_v4.description: Analysis of failure shifting between matched V4 and V5 across 165 tasks.
